about: The elevator announcer's lines. `text` is sent to ElevenLabs exactly as written (audio tags included); `plain` is the subtitle. See docs/VOICE.md.

shortlist.name: Bella
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Bella - Professional, Bright, Warm': American, middle-aged, professional; warm, bright and polished, medium-high pitch.
shortlist.why: Its own description is the default register: bright, warm, professional. Chosen as the default from the description alone (nobody has heard it).

shortlist.name: Sarah
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Sarah - Mature, Reassuring, Confident': American, professional, labelled for entertainment and TV; warm and reassuring.
shortlist.why: A reassuring presenter: the 'everything is fine' side of the character.

shortlist.name: Brian
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting': American, middle-aged man; resonant and comforting, described as great for advertisements.
shortlist.why: An advertising voice, and a male alternative so the owner can compare.

board.when: the start of a run, in the car before the doors open

doors.when: the doors open on a new floor (not the run's first floor: the boarding line covers it)

left.when: the car leaves the crew on the floor (unloaded, or the bell rang with nobody aboard)

arrived.when: the called car arrives and its doors open

bell.when: seven seconds before the doors close while boarding

ride.when: the car rides down to a deeper floor

banked.when: the crew rides up and banks

taken.when: someone is caught by the Orderly

wipe.when: nobody is left: the run is wiped

slip.when: at most once per run, floor 2 or deeper, at a quiet moment; then a pause and the resume line

resume.when: straight after the slip and its pause, as if nothing happened

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Good morning, and welcome aboard! [short pause] Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.plain: Good morning, and welcome aboard! Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.note: Hotel-lobby warmth. 'Sentence' lands as good news.

lines.text: [warmly] Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. [short pause] Statistically.
lines.plain: Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. Statistically.
lines.note: The last word is an afterthought, still smiling, not a joke it knows it made.

lines.text: [delighted] Doors opening! [short pause] This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.plain: Doors opening! This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.note: Tour-guide trivia. The second sentence is fond, not ominous.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.plain: Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.note: Standard airline cadence; the end is said exactly like the start.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] The car is leaving now! [short pause] Call any time. It usually comes.
lines.plain: The car is leaving now! Call any time. It usually comes.

lines.text: [warmly] We'll be just upstairs! [short pause] [delighted] Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.plain: We'll be just upstairs! Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.note: A parent leaving a child at a party.

lines.text: [professional] Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. [mischievously] Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.plain: Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.note: Customer service, then a little conspiratorial twinkle, as if sharing good gossip.

lines.text: [delighted] Your call is important to us! [short pause] Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
lines.plain: Your call is important to us! Please wait right there, exactly where you are.

lines.text: [delighted] Your car has arrived! [short pause] Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.plain: Your car has arrived! Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.note: Audition: the normal read. Pleased to see you.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Your car is here! [warmly] We missed you.
lines.plain: Your car is here! We missed you.
lines.note: Short and sweet. 'We missed you' sincere.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. [short pause] Choose freely!
lines.plain: Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. Choose freely!

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.plain: Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.note: The ellipsis is a happy search for the right word.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Going down! [short pause] Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.plain: Going down! Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.note: Proud of the policy. No wink.

lines.text: [delighted] Next stop, further down! [short pause] Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
lines.plain: Next stop, further down! Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.

lines.text: [ecstatic] Congratulations! [short pause] Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now SLIGHTLY nearer.
lines.plain: Congratulations! Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now slightly nearer.
lines.note: Prize-giving. The capital word is emphasised with pride, not irony.

lines.text: [warmly] A member of your crew has been reassigned. [short pause] [delighted] Their sentence is complete!
lines.plain: A member of your crew has been reassigned. Their sentence is complete!
lines.note: Audition: the bad-news read. Announcing a promotion.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] And that is everyone! [short pause] Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.plain: And that is everyone! Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.note: End of a shift. Brisk, satisfied, already thinking about the next one.

lines.text: [Flat, quiet, no warmth, close to the microphone] Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.plain: Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.note: Audition: the slip. No smile at all, as if someone else is holding the microphone. Followed in game by a pause and resume_1.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.plain: Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.note: Back to full cheer at once, as if nothing happened.
